name: El Nido
tagline: Limestone cliffs rising from emerald lagoons in Bacuit Bay, with secret beaches, hidden coves and some of the most photographed seascapes in Asia.
highlight: Paddling a kayak through the narrow entrance of the Secret Lagoon into a hidden pool ringed by cliffs.
shortDescription: A small Palawan town at the edge of Bacuit Bay, the base for island-hopping tours to the Big and Small Lagoons, Secret Lagoon, Shimizu Island and Nacpan Beach.
metaDescription: An El Nido travel guide: island-hopping tours A, B, C and D, Big Lagoon, Secret Lagoon, Nacpan Beach, Cadlao Island, diving, where to stay, how to get there and a four-day plan.
nearestAirport: El Nido Lio Airport (ENI) has limited flights; Puerto Princesa (PPS), about 5–6 hours by van
knownFor: Island hopping, lagoons, limestone karst, beaches

intro: El Nido sits at the northern tip of Palawan, an elongated island in the west of the Philippines, on the edge of Bacuit Bay. The bay holds 45 islands and islets, mostly limestone karst, whose sheer cliffs, caves and lagoons feel like a fantasy landscape. The area is part of the Bacuit Archipelago and Palawan, often named the best island in the world by travel magazines.

The town itself is small and functional, a strip of guesthouses, dive shops, restaurants and tour offices on a curved beach. Visitors come for island-hopping: standard tours, called A, B, C and D, run by outriggers that visit lagoons such as the Big Lagoon and Small Lagoon, the Secret Lagoon, Shimizu Island, 7 Commando Beach, Hidden Beach, Matinloc Shrine and Helicopter Island. Each tour costs the same and covers different sites, so many visitors do two or three.

El Nido has grown fast, and can be crowded at peak times. Booking early tours, choosing small groups, and visiting quieter places like Nacpan Beach, Cadlao Island and Corong-Corong makes for a better trip. Weather is best from December to May, and the sea can be too rough for boats in the rainy season.

whyVisit.intro: El Nido is the best place in the Philippines for classic lagoon-and-limestone scenery.
